judged evaluation cases.relevance judging basis: A retrieval unit must explain which data identify the originating record, the originating record version, and the exact location of the supporting passage.

relevance judgments.rationale: F-B describes a proposal-run receipt that records the source and version of the model used to produce a concept proposal. It does not identify the originating knowledge record and its version or locate the exact supporting passage, so it does not satisfy the relevance judging basis.
